text: The SICAM A8000 CP-8031 is a compact and scalable RTU designed for cost‑efficient automation and communication tasks in distribution networks and industrial applications. It can be used as a simple gateway, IoT gateway, or bay controller and integrates seamlessly into the SICAM A8000 system architecture.
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: The SICAM A8000 CP-8031 enables the following benefits:
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: Scalable and affordable RTU: compact design with flexible scalability at an attractive price point
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: Versatile application support: usable as gateway, IoT gateway, or bay controller
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: High availability: support for network redundancy and fiber‑optic interface modules
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: Future‑proof and secure platform: based on proven SICAM A8000 technology with IEC 62443‑2 certified cybersecurity
heading: Why SICAM A8000 CP-8031?

text: SICAM CP‑8031 is a compact Linux‑based RTU for gateway and IoT applications. It unifies communication, automation and security, enabling reliable data acquisition and integration in tight installation spaces.
heading: Compact and versatile RTU

text: SICAM CP-8031 is a cost‑efficient RTU delivering essential automation, communication, and security in one compact device. Its scalable design reduces hardware, engineering, and lifecycle costs for budget‑conscious projects.
heading: Affordable, compact RTU

text: SICAM CP-8031 offers strong cybersecurity with firewall, role-based access, and encrypted communication. It ensures secure data exchange between field devices and control systems, meeting modern by demanding security requirements.
heading: Secure communication for critical infrastructures

text: SICAM CP‑8031 acts as a simple gateway, securely connecting field devices to control systems. It supports reliable data acquisition and protocol forwarding, helping reduce system complexity in small and medium automation projects.
heading: Simple Gateway Solution

text: SICAM CP‑8031 functions as an IoT gateway, collecting field data and securely forwarding it to cloud or IoT platforms. This enables efficient monitoring, analytics, and integration of distributed assets without extra hardware.
heading: IoT Gateway

text: SICAM CP‑8031 can be used as a compact bay controller, combining control, monitoring, and communication in one device. It supports reliable bay operation in substations and industrial plants with secure system integration.
heading: Bay controller

text: SICAM A8000 CP-8031 in Power Utilities

The SICAM CP‑8031 is a compact and powerful RTU for power utilities, supporting use as a bay controller, simple gateway solution, or IoT gateway. It enables reliable monitoring, control, and data integration in distribution and transmission grids, combining scalable performance, secure communication, and flexible application support.
